top_5_failure_modes.name: Context-Deprived Mid-Thread Tweets
top_5_failure_modes.description: Customer tweets referring to earlier email/phone conversations ('I already replied', 'Did you get my DM?'). Classifier struggles due to missing conversation history.
top_5_failure_modes.mitigation: Integrate Twitter conversation thread reconstruction before classification; route contextless replies to dedicated thread-continuation queue.

top_5_failure_modes.name: Intent Boundary Overlap (Cancellation vs Refund vs Account)
top_5_failure_modes.description: Cross-intent queries such as 'Cancel Prime membership and refund $14.99' or 'Accidental purchase return'.
top_5_failure_modes.mitigation: Adopt multi-label classification or hierarchical taxonomy (Order -> Delivery/Cancel; Billing -> Refund/Charge).

top_5_failure_modes.name: Cross-Lingual & Regional Marketplace Misalignment
top_5_failure_modes.description: Tweets in French, German, Japanese, Spanish mentioning regional domain links (amazon.fr, amazon.de). Lexical TF-IDF has lower recall across non-English vocabulary.
top_5_failure_modes.mitigation: Deploy language detection filter + multilingual embeddings (e.g. multilingual E5 or XLM-RoBERTa).

top_5_failure_modes.name: Lexical Keyword Bias in TF-IDF Retrieval
top_5_failure_modes.description: TF-IDF matching frequent words ('package', 'Amazon', 'order') rather than specific failure symptoms ('stuck at customs', 'shattered ceramic').
top_5_failure_modes.mitigation: Upgrade retrieval baseline to hybrid BM25 + dense semantic retrieval.

top_5_failure_modes.name: False Escalation on High-Frustration Routine Queries
top_5_failure_modes.description: Customers expressing strong irritation ('worst service ever, where is my order') triggering frustration escalation even when self-service tracking link is sufficient.
top_5_failure_modes.mitigation: Decouple sentiment polarity from intent routing; auto-handle routine queries with empathetic apology while escalating only true complex claims.
